item.name: infrastructure
item.description: Campus infrastructure: **Building → Floor → Class room** (`/building`, `/floor`, `/classRoom`). Auth: Bearer `{{token}}`. Use **get all nested** for the full tree in one call; use flat GETs on `/floor` and `/classRoom` when you only need one level.

floor.floorId — set from floor create or nested floorBuilding[].floorId
class_room_section.classRoomSectionId

request.description:
**POST /building**

Creates a building under the logged-in user's campus (resolved from `defaultInstituteId` saved at login).

**Required body:** `name`, `buildingType`, `description`, `openingTime`, `closingTime`

**buildingType** (enum): `Academics` | `Residential`

**GET /building**

Flat list of buildings with nested `campusbuilding` (campus details). Does not include floors or rooms.

query.description: Optional — `Academics` | `Residential`; omit for all building types

request.description:
**GET /building/allNested**

Returns buildings for the authenticated user's university with full infrastructure nesting:

**Building** → `floorBuilding[]` (floors) → `roomFloor[]` (class rooms)

- Scoped by `req.user.universityId` via campus membership
- Audit fields excluded

**Query (optional)**
| Key | Values |
|-----|--------|
| `buildingType` | `Academics` \| `Residential` |

**Examples**
- `GET .../building/allNested` — all types
- `GET .../building/allNested?buildingType=Academics` — academic buildings and their floors/rooms
- `GET .../building/allNested?buildingType=Residential` — residential buildings and their floors/rooms

**GET /building/single?buildingId=**

Single building with `campusbuilding` include.

**PATCH /building**

**Required body:** `buildingId`
**DELETE /building?buildingId=**

**POST /floor**

**Required body:** `name`, `buildingId`

**GET /floor**

Flat list of floors with parent `floorBuilding` (building).
**GET /floor/single?floorId=**

**PATCH /floor**

**Required body:** `floorId`
**DELETE /floor?floorId=**

**POST /classRoom**

**Required body:** `roomNumber`, `capacity`, `floorId`

**Optional:** `examCapacity`, `examCapacityColumns` (nullable numbers)

**GET /classRoom**

Flat list with `roomFloor` → `floorBuilding` includes.
**GET /classRoom/single?classRoomSectionId=**

**PATCH /classRoom**

**Required body:** `classRoomSectionId`
**DELETE /classRoom?classRoomSectionId=**

**GET /session**

Returns sessions for the authenticated user's **default institute only** (not other institutes). Includes `courseMappings` for that institute.

Optional query: `acedmicYearId`.

**POST /session/courseSessionMapping**

Maps one or more courses to a session for the user's institute.

**PATCH /session/courseSessionMapping/update**

Requires `sessionCourseMappingId` in body.

query.description: Required. Fails if related data exists (class sections, syllabus, students, fee plans, etc.).

request.description:
**DELETE /session/courseSessionMapping**

Unmaps a course from a session. Blocked when dependent data already exists for that course–session pair.

**GET /subject/withExamSchedule**

Query: `examSetupTypeTermId` (required), `sessionId` (optional).

Returns:
- `studentCount` / `studentList` — enrolled students for course + term
- `subjects[]` — each subject includes `scheduleSubject[]` (exam schedule rows). Per schedule: `isRoomAllocated` (true when rooms assigned), `roomNames` (e.g. `["A-101","B-202"]`), `rooms` (room assignment details with `roomNumber`, `capacity`, `orderKey`)

item.name: time table
item.description: Timetable structure (`/timeTable`) and routine (`/timeTableCreate`). Folder vars `timetable_*` — edit on this folder's Variables tab. Auth uses global `{{token}}` and `{{baseurl}}`.

variable.description: Course PK — scopes institute + academic year on GET when provided
Session PK — required with courseId on POST; optional filter on GET
Academic year — optional on GET; fallback is user defaultAcademicYearId when courseId is set

Class section PK — timeTableCreate getRoutine

request.description:
**POST /timeTable**

Creates a timetable **structure** (period slots) for a course.

### Required body
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `name` | Structure name |
| `maximumPeriod` | Number of periods |
| `periodLength` | Minutes |
| `periodGap` | Minutes between periods |
| `startingTime` | e.g. `09:00 AM` |
| `type` | `Automatic` or `Manual` |

### Course scope
When `courseId` is sent, also send **`sessionId`** (or `acedmicYearId` in body). Server resolves:
- `instituteId` from the course
- `acedmicYearId` from the session (or body / user `defaultAcademicYearId`)
- Validates session is mapped to the course

### Optional
- `weekOff` — JSON array on structure row, e.g. `["Sunday"]`
- `isCourse` — boolean on each generated period
- `acedmicYearId` — only if not inferable from session

### Success
**200** — array of created period rows (`timeTableCreationId`, `periodName`, `startTime`, `endTime`, …). Test script saves first `timeTableCreationId` to `timetable_creationId`.

query.description: Optional — when set, filters by course institute + academic year
Optional — defaults to user defaultAcademicYearId when courseId is set

request.description:
**GET /timeTable**

Lists timetable structures with periods, course, session (`timeTableSession`), and `weekOff` on the structure row.

When `courseId` is in query, results are scoped to that course's institute and academic year.

query.description: Scopes institute + academic year when provided
Optional — defaults when courseId is set

request.description:
**GET /timeTable/all_name**

Same payload shape as **GET /timeTable** — structures with `weekOff`, `timeTableSession`, course, and nested periods.

**GET /timeTable/single**

Filtered list for one course/session (institute + academic year scope when `courseId` is set). Includes session info and `weekOff`.

**PATCH /timeTable**

Array of period updates. Each object must include `timeTableCreationId`.

**DELETE /timeTable?timeTableCreationId=**

Soft-deletes one period row.

**GET /timeTableCreate/getRoutine**

Routine grid for a class section. Includes structure `weekOff` on linked timetable name.

request.description:
**GET /lesson/employee**

Teacher subject mappings with nested subject, lessons, topics, and semester.

Query: `employeeId`, optional `courseId`, `sessionId`, `subjectSearch`. No `acedmicYearId` needed — session scopes lessons.

**GET /teacher/teacherSubject**

Lists teacher–subject mappings with nested employee, class-subject mapper, subject, semester, and class section.

**Query:** optional `employeeId`, optional `subjectId` (filters `class_subject_mapper.subject_id`). Scoped by token `universityId` and `defaultInstituteId`.

query.description: Required. Returns rooms free for this exam slot (no other exam or class conflict).

request.description:
**GET /examSchedule/availableRooms**

Returns rooms available for room assignment for the given `examScheduleId`.

Each room includes: `roomNumber`, `capacity`, `examCapacity`, `examCapacityColumns`, `effectiveExamCapacity` (`examCapacity` or fallback `capacity`).

Excludes rooms that are:
- Assigned to another overlapping exam on the same date
- Used by a class on that day/time (timetable)
- Already assigned to this exam
- Soft-deleted or under inactive building hierarchy

Response also includes slot info: `examDate`, `examTime`, `duration`, `slotStartTime`, `slotEndTime`, `day`.

**POST /examSchedule/assignRoom**

Assigns rooms to an exam schedule. `classRoomSectionIds` accepts room IDs or `{ classRoomSectionId, orderKey }` objects (order 1..n, no gaps).

Total `effectiveExamCapacity` must be >= enrolled student count. Uses a DB transaction for writes.

Call **GET /examSchedule/availableRooms** first to list conflict-free rooms.

**PUT /examSchedule/roomAssignment**

Updates capacity/columns for an existing room assignment. Uses a DB transaction.

item.name: get room assignments by exam schedule

**GET /examSchedule/roomAssignments**

Returns assigned room details for a scheduled exam.

item.name: exam schedule mapping
item.description:
Exam date/time scheduling under `/examScheduleMapping`.

**POST /schedule** creates an `exam_schedule` row. `acedmicYearId` is taken from the authenticated user's `defaultAcademicYearId` (not sent in body).

**Student time conflict:** rejects when another exam for the same student cohort (same `sessionId`, academic year, `courseId` + `term` from `examSetupTypeTermId`, and `semesterId` when provided) overlaps on the same `examDate` (`examTime` + `duration`).

request.description:
**POST /examScheduleMapping/schedule**

Creates an exam schedule (date/time slot for a subject).

### Required body
| Field | Notes |
|-------|--------|
| `examSetupTypeTermId` | Links to course + term |
| `sessionId` | Session for enrolled students |
| `subjectId` | Subject being scheduled |
| `examDate` | `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `examTime` | e.g. `10:00:00` |
| `duration` | Minutes as string, e.g. `"120"` |
| `type` | e.g. `Theory` |

Optional: `semesterId` — when set, conflict check is scoped to that semester.

### Server-set
- `acedmicYearId` from token user's `defaultAcademicYearId`
- `createdBy` / `updatedBy` from token user

### Conflict rule
Returns **500** with message like:
`Cannot schedule exam: {subjectName} is already scheduled at the same time for the same students`

when another exam overlaps for the same course/term/session cohort.

### Success
**201** — `{ message, examSchedule }`. Test script saves `examScheduleId` to `{{examScheduleMapping_examScheduleId}}`.
**GET /examScheduleMapping/getScheduleById/:id**

query.description: Optional — session academic year + course mapping validation

request.description:

**Query:** `courseId`, `term` (required for typical use). Optional `sessionId` when you need session-scoped academic year.

**GET /options/feePlans** — v2 only. Query: courseId, sessionId. Returns **published** plans only. data: { courseSessionId, profiles: [{ feePlanProfileId, name }] }. Run **feePlanProfile → publish** first.

request.description:
**POST /studentHallTicket/generate**

**One-time only:** if any hall ticket already exists for that exam setup term + session (same institute/university), returns **400** — regeneration is not allowed.

Otherwise **creates** one row per eligible student (new QR each). **Requires at least one** `exam_schedule` row for that pair with **both** `examDate` and `examTime` (one scheduled subject is enough for Mid-term / End-sem, etc.).

**Body** uses folder vars `hallticket_examSetupTypeTermId`, `hallticket_sessionId`.

**GET /studentHallTicket**

Optional filters: **`examSetupTypeTermId`**, **`sessionId`**, **`studentId`** (folder vars). **Pagination:** **`page`** (default 1), **`limit`** (default **1000** if omitted; each request clamps **`limit`** to **10–1000**). Response **`data`** is the current page of hall tickets; **`paginationData`** has **`total`**, **`page`**, **`limit`**, **`totalPages`** (same pattern as GET `/questionPaper`).

**GET /studentHallTicket/:id**

Path id = `hallticket_hallTicketId`. Top level: student/session/exam-type fields; **`subjects`** lists every `exam_schedule` for this ticket’s term + session. Each item has flat fields (`subjectId`, `subjectName`, …) plus nested **`subject`** (full subject row: type, term, course, etc.) and **`semester`** when linked.

item.name: library creation
item.description: Library APIs under `/libraryCreation` (test in order: library → get single library (set `libraryFloor_id`) → floor structure POST/GET → categories → add book → bookSummary/allBook/singleBook → updateBook → bulk upload). Auth: Bearer {{token}}.

request.description:
**POST /libraryCreation/floor/:libraryFloorId/structure**

Bulk-creates aisles, racks, and rows (shelves) for a floor in one transaction.

- **Aisle** `name` continues from the highest existing numeric aisle on the floor (e.g. day 1: 1–5, day 2 with `aisles: 2` → 6–7).
- **Rack** / **row** names start at `1` within each new aisle/rack.
- **description** is auto-set: `aisle 1`, `aisle 1 rack 2`, `aisle 1 rack 2 row 2`.

**Body:** `aisles`, `racksPerAisle`, `rowsPerRack` (all integers ≥ 1).

Set `libraryFloor_id` from **get single library** `floors[].libraryFloorId`.

**GET /libraryCreation/floor/:libraryFloorId/structure**

Returns nested floor layout: **aisles → racks → shelves** (rows). Sorted numerically by `name`. Includes `description` on each level.

response.name: 200 OK — example

request.description:
**POST /libraryCreation/addBook**

Creates one `library_book` row from `book` payload and one-or-more `library_book_inventory` rows from `inventory` array in a single transaction.

Supports both `accessionNumber` and legacy `accessionNo` (mapped to `accessionNumber`).

**Full payload example:**

```json
    "libraryCreationId": 1,
    "libraryFloorId": 1,

    "subtitle": "Third Edition",
    "authors": "Thomas H. Cormen",

    "placeOfPublication": "Cambridge",
    "yearOfPublication": 2009,

    "volumeNumber": "1",
    "language": "English",
    "isbn": "9780262033848",
    "issn": null,
    "barcode": "BK-ALG-0001",
    "physicalDescription": "Hardcover",
    "numberOfPages": 1312,
    "illustrations": true,
    "summary": "Comprehensive algorithms textbook",
    "keywords": "algorithms,data structures,computer science",
    "additionalAuthor": "Charles E. Leiserson",
    "subjectId": [1, 2],
    "categoryId": [{{libraryCategory_id}}],
    "classSectionsId": 0,
    "remark": "",
    "itemType": "print"
  },
  "inventory": [
    {
      "accessionNumber": "ACC-1001",
      "libraryAisleId": 1,

```

request.description:
**GET /libraryCreation/bookSummary**

Dashboard summary for the Book List page.

**Query**
| Key | Required | Notes |
|-----|----------|--------|
| `libraryCreationId` | Yes | Library ID |
| `libraryFloorId` | No | Floor scope; omit for whole library |

**Response `data`**
| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `totalBooks` | Distinct book titles in scope |
| `inStock` | Inventory copies with `status = available` (issued copies excluded) |
| `lowStock` | Books with available copies ≤ `LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD` (2), including books with no copies |
| `totalCopies` | Total inventory copies in scope |

**Examples**
- `GET .../bookSummary?libraryCreationId=1`
- `GET .../bookSummary?libraryCreationId=1&libraryFloorId=1`

request.description:
**GET /libraryCreation/allBook**

Paginated book list. Use **`search`** only for lookup (all former filter fields merged). Sorted by `libraryBookId` DESC.

**Query (6 keys)**
| Key | Required | Default | Notes |
|-----|----------|---------|--------|
| `libraryCreationId` | Yes | — | Library ID |
| `libraryFloorId` | No | — | Floor scope; omit for whole library |
| `page` | No | 1 | Page number |
| `limit` | No | 20 | Max 100 |
| `search` | No | — | One field: book + inventory fields; omit for all |

**`search` matches:** title, subtitle, authors, isbn, publisher, keywords, accessionNumber, status, billNo, billDate, numeric `libraryBookId`

**Examples**
- `GET .../allBook?libraryCreationId=1&page=1&limit=20`
- `GET .../allBook?libraryCreationId=1&libraryFloorId=1&search=design&page=1&limit=20`
- `GET .../allBook?libraryCreationId=1&search=available&page=1&limit=20`

**Response:** `data[]` + `paginationData`

item.description:
**POST /libraryCreation/bulkUpload?libraryCreationId=**

Upload an Excel file (`.xlsx`). Each row = one inventory copy.

**Query**
| Key | Required |
|-----|----------|
| `libraryCreationId` | Yes |

**Body (form-data)**
| Key | Type | Required |
|-----|------|----------|
| `book` | file | Yes |

**Required Excel columns (every row)**
`isbn`, `accessionNumber`, `Aisle`, `Rack`, `Row`

**Required only when ISBN is new in DB**
`title`, `authors`

**Optional book columns**
`publisher`, `keywords`, `subtitle`, `barcode`, `itemType`, …

**Logic**
- ISBN exists → inventory row only
- ISBN new → book + inventory
- Same ISBN twice in file → first row creates book, next rows inventory only

**Success**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Data uploaded successfully" }
```

**Error**
```json
{ "message": "Row 2: Rack is required" }
```

item.name: library issue book
item.description:
Library issue/return flow under `/libraryIssueBook`.

**Test order:** create → get all/get single → **get inventory issue history** (by `inventoryId`) → update with `returnItems` (partial/full return) → update due date/inventory if needed.

**Rules**
- `memberType`: `STUDENT` | `TEACHER`; `memberId` maps to student/employee PK
- Transaction: `issueDate`, `dueDate` (`dueDate` >= `issueDate`)
- Return is stored in `library_return_book_transaction`; inventory item links via `libraryReturnBookTransactionId`
- Active issue = item row with `libraryReturnBookTransactionId` NULL; same `inventoryId` can be re-issued after return
- For same `returnDate`, one return transaction can be reused for multiple returned items
- `library_book_inventory.status`: `available` → `issued` on issue, back to `available` on return
- `inventoryItems[]` on update replaces outstanding copies (auto-returns old active items)
- `returnItems[]` on update returns selected books by item id or inventory id
- **GET /inventoryIssueHistory?inventoryId=** — accession copy + all issue rows for that inventory (nested `bookDetails`, `issueBookTransaction` with `studentMember` / `teacherMember`)

Auth: Bearer {{token}}

request.description:
**POST /libraryIssueBook**

Creates transaction + items (initially `libraryReturnBookTransactionId` is `null`). Sets each `library_book_inventory.status` to `issued`.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `memberId`, `memberType` | Yes | STUDENT → student_id, TEACHER → employee_id |
| `issueDate`, `dueDate` | Yes | `dueDate` >= `issueDate` |
| `inventoryItems[]` | No | Copy must be `available`; unique per request |

**GET /libraryIssueBook**

List issue transactions with pagination and common search.

### Params type (frontend)

```ts
type GetAllIssueTransactionsQuery = {
  page?: number; // default 1
  limit?: number; // default 20
  search?: string; // optional common search
};
```

### Notes
- Send params in query string (no request body)
- `search` works across member/date/book related fields

**GET /libraryIssueBook/inventoryIssueHistory**

Query: `inventoryId` (required) — `library_book_inventory.inventory_id` (accession copy).

Returns:
- `book` — inventory row with nested `bookDetails` (`title`, `authors`, `isbn`, `accessionNumber`, `status`, …)
- `issueCount` — total issue entries for this copy
- `issueHistory[]` — each `library_book_issue_inventory_item` with nested `issueBookTransaction` (`issueDate`, `dueDate`, `memberType`, `studentMember` or `teacherMember`) and optional `returnBookTransaction` (`libraryReturnBookTransactionId`, `returnDate`)

404 when `inventoryId` not found.

**GET /libraryIssueBook/returnTransactions**

Lists return batches grouped by `library_return_book_transaction` (one row per **returnDate**). Multiple books returned on the same date appear under the same record.

### Query params

```ts
type GetReturnTransactionsQuery = {
  page?: number; // default 1
  limit?: number; // default 20
  search?: string; // returnDate, member, accession, title, isbn, …
};
```

`{{baseurl}}/libraryIssueBook/returnTransactions?page={{page}}&limit={{limit}}&search={{search}}`

### Response shape (per row)

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `libraryReturnBookTransactionId` | PK of return batch |
| `returnDate` | Shared date for all books in this batch |
| `totalReturnedBooks` | Count of copies in this batch |
| `totalIssueTransactions` | Distinct issue transactions involved |
| `issueTransactions[]` | Grouped by original issue |

Each `issueTransactions[]` entry:
- `libraryIssueBookTransactionId`, `memberId`, `memberType`, `issueDate`, `dueDate`, `member`
- `returnedBooks[]` — `{ libraryBookIssueInventoryItemId, inventoryId, book }` (`book` includes `bookDetails`)

### Example (two books, same returnDate)

```json
{
  "libraryReturnBookTransactionId": 3,
  "returnDate": "2026-06-02",
  "totalReturnedBooks": 2,
  "totalIssueTransactions": 1,
  "issueTransactions": [
    {
      "libraryIssueBookTransactionId": 12,
      "memberType": "STUDENT",
      "returnedBooks": [
        { "libraryBookIssueInventoryItemId": 5, "inventoryId": 101, "book": { } },
        { "libraryBookIssueInventoryItemId": 6, "inventoryId": 102, "book": { } }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Run after **PATCH** with multiple `returnItems` sharing `{{return_date}}` to verify grouping.

Returns library members list.

item.description: Fee plans v2. **POST /** (draft) → **PATCH /** edit → **PATCH /publish** → **PATCH /assignStudent**. **GET /summary**, **GET /all**, **GET /single**. Dropdown: **GET /options/feePlans** (published only).

request.description:
Creates fee_plan_profile + fee_plan_item + fee_plan_sub_items.

**Required:** `name`, `planType`, `category`, `courseSessionId`.

**publishStatus** (optional): `draft` (default) | `published`. Draft plans appear in lists but cannot be assigned to students.

**feePlanItems[]** (same shape as PATCH/GET): createDate, dueDate, feePlanSubItems[].

planType: annual | semester | trimester. academicYearId optional.
**PATCH /feePlanProfile** — updatable: `name`, `planType`, `category`, `courseSessionId`, `academicYearId`, `feePlanItems`. Use **publish** to make plan assignable.

**PATCH /feePlanProfile/publish**

Sets `publishStatus` to `published` (required before assign student, POST /student with fee plan, or POST /studentFeeInvoice).

**Body:** `{ "feePlanProfileId": number }` — uses `{{feePlanProfile_id}}` from **create**.

**Rules:** Plan must have ≥1 term, each with ≥1 fee line. Already published → 400.

**200:** Same shape as GET single (`publishStatus: published`).

**Next:** assignStudent → options/feePlans → studentFeeInvoice generate.

**GET /feePlanProfile/summary** — dashboard cards on Fees Invoice page.

- **activeFeePlans**: fee_plan_profile assigned to ≥1 student (students.fee_plan_profile_id)
- **inactiveFeePlans**: profiles not assigned to any student
- **allFeePlans**: total profiles for institute

**GET /feePlanProfile/all?status=**

- **all** — every fee plan for institute
- **active** — assigned to ≥1 student (students.fee_plan_profile_id)
- **inactive** — no student assigned

**data:** { status, feePlans[] }
Fee plans with ≥1 student assigned. Response: { status: "active", feePlans[] }.
Fee plans with zero students assigned. Response: { status: "inactive", feePlans[] }.

Query: courseSessionId (required). Response data: { courseSessionId, feePlans[] } — each plan: numberOfInvoices (term invoices via fee_plan_item), feePlanItems[{ sno, feePlanItemId, numberOfInvoices }], assignedStudentCount, status, termFees, totalFees, etc.

**GET /feePlanProfile/single?feePlanProfileId=**

Formatted detail (no raw timestamps on nested catalog).

**Profile:** planName, planType, courseSessionId, **courseName**, **sessionName**, courseId, sessionId, assignedStudentCount, numberOfInvoices, status (active|inactive), term, termFees, supplementalFees, totalFees.

**feePlanItems[]:** sno, feePlanItemId, createDate, dueDate, total, numberOfInvoices, feePlanSubItems[{ feePlanSubitemId, name, amount, feeTypeId, isMainSubItem }].

**PATCH /feePlanProfile/assignStudent** — only **`publishStatus: published`** plans.

**Body:** `studentId`, `feePlanProfileId`. Draft plans return 400.

**GET /options/feePlans** lists published plans only.

item.name: studentFeeInvoice
item.description: Invoices v2. Term: POST / with feePlanItemId. Adhoc: POST /adhoc with feeTypeCatalogs[] (+ optional waiver). List institute: GET /all?status=all|pending|completed. By student: GET /?studentId= returns { student, invoices[] }. Detail: GET /single.

request.description:
**POST /studentFeeInvoice** — term / fee-plan invoice.

Body: studentId, feePlanItemId only. instituteId from auth.

Creates **student_fee_invoice** (linked to **fee_plan_item**, no amount column) + **student_fee_invoice_items** rows copied from **fee_plan_sub_items** (isMainItem = isMainSubItem).

Response: **feeInvoiceItems[]**; **amount** = main line; **supplementalFees** = supplemental.

201 message: "Invoice generated". data: studentFeeInvoiceId, amount, total, totalVerified, supplementalFees[], feePlanItem, student (if loaded).

**POST /studentFeeInvoice/adhoc** — adhoc invoice (misconduct, fine, etc.). No feePlanItemId.

**Body (required):** studentId, feeTypeCatalogs[] (min 1), createDate (YYYY-MM-DD).

**feeTypeCatalogs[] each line:** feeTypeCatalogId, amount; optional waiver (≥ 0, cannot exceed amount).

**Invoice total** = sum of (amount − waiver) per line. Example: 5000−500 + 3000−500 = **7000** (not 8000 gross).

**Optional:** dueDate (null allowed), total — if sent, must equal net sum after waivers; omit total to auto-compute.

**Stored:** student_fee_invoice_items.amount (gross), .waiver; student_fee_invoice.total only (no amount column).

instituteId from auth.

201 data (minimal): studentFeeInvoiceId, studentId, total, createDate, dueDate, paymentStatus. Use GET /studentFeeInvoice/single for full detail.

**GET /studentFeeInvoice/all?status=**

- **all** — every generated invoice
- **pending** — unpaid + partial
- **completed** — paid

**data:** { status, invoices[] } — studentFeeInvoiceId, studentName, scholarNumber, amount, paid, balanceDue, paymentStatus, createDate, dueDate.
Unpaid and partial invoices only. Same response shape as status=all.
Paid invoices only. Same response shape as status=all.

**GET /studentFeeInvoice?studentId=** — v2 replacement for GET /student/:id/feeDetails.

**data:** { student: { studentId, studentName, scholarNumber }, invoices[] } — each invoice: studentFeeInvoiceId, total, paymentStatus, totalPaid, balanceDue, supplementalFees[{ name, amount }].

**GET /studentFeeInvoice/single?studentFeeInvoiceId=**

Full invoice detail. data includes:
- studentFeeInvoiceId, studentId, feePlanItemId, instituteId
- **student** — studentId, firstName, middleName, lastName, studentName, scholarNumber, email, mobileNumber, enrollNumber, feePlanProfileId
- amount, supplementalFeesTotal, total, storedTotal, totalVerified
- createDate, dueDate, status, paymentStatus, totalPaid, balanceDue
- feePlanItem (term; null fields for adhoc)
- feeInvoiceItems[] — studentFeeInvoiceItemsId, feeTypeId, isMainItem, amount, waiver, netAmount
- supplementalFees[] — supplemental lines only (isMainItem=false)

item.name: studentFeePayment
item.description:
## studentFeePayment (fee v2)

Run in order:
1. **GET /payment/details?studentId=** — outstanding invoices (pay screen)
2. **POST /payment/details** — record payment (multi-invoice in one payment)
3. **GET /** — paginated payment list (print)
4. **GET /single?studentFeePaymentId=** — one payment receipt with paymentItems

## Amount rules (POST only)
- **total** ← `student_fee_invoice_items` (sum amount − waiver)
- **paidAmount** ← `payment_item` SUM
- **dueAmount** = total − paidAmount; reject if amount > dueAmount

## Tables
`student_fee_payment` (header: payeeId, payeeType STUDENT|VENDOR|OTHER) + `payment_item` (referenceId, referenceType; fee invoice uses referenceType `STUDENT_FEE_INVOICE` and referenceId = studentFeeInvoiceId; omit referenceType → saves as `OTHER`)

request.description:
**GET /studentFeePayment/payment/details?studentId=**

Pay screen: student summary + outstanding invoices + aggregates.

**Summary fields:**
- `totalInvoices` — count of generated invoices for this student
- `lastPayment` — latest INCOMING payment (`studentFeePaymentId`, `amount`, `paymentMethod`, `paymentDate`) or `null`
- `outstandingAmount` — sum of `balanceDue` on unpaid/partial invoices
- `totalPaymentReceived` — sum of **payment_item** amounts (INCOMING) across all student invoices

**Per invoice (in `invoices[]`, unpaid/partial only):**
- `total` from **student_fee_invoice_items** (sum amount − waiver)
- `paidAmount` from **payment_item** SUM
- `balanceDue` = total − paidAmount

**data:** `{ student, totalInvoices, lastPayment, outstandingAmount, totalPaymentReceived, invoices[] }`

Set `student_id` and `studentFeeInvoice_id` (use as paymentItems[].referenceId) before POST.

**POST /studentFeePayment/payment/details**

**Body (required):**
```json
{
  "payeeId": 2152,
  "payeeType": "STUDENT",
  "amount": "8000.00",
  "paymentItems": [
    { "referenceId": 42, "referenceType": "STUDENT_FEE_INVOICE", "amount": "5000.00" },
    { "referenceId": 43, "referenceType": "STUDENT_FEE_INVOICE", "amount": "3000.00" }
  ],
  "paymentMethod": "cash",
  "receivedBy": "Receiver name or username",
  "remark": ""
}
```

- **payeeType** (required): `STUDENT` | `VENDOR` | `OTHER`. Fee invoices require `STUDENT`.
- **paymentItems[]**: `referenceId` (required), `amount` (required), `referenceType` (optional — defaults to `OTHER` if omitted).
- **referenceType** `STUDENT_FEE_INVOICE`: validates invoice, updates `paid_amount` / `payment_status`. `STUDENT_LIBRARY_INVOICE` not supported yet.
- **amount** must equal sum of `paymentItems[].amount`.

**Optional:** paymentType (default INCOMING), referenceNumber, transactionId (auto UUID if omitted), receivedBy, remark.

**data:** `{ payment, verified: { payeeId, total, paymentItems[] } }` — verified items include referenceId, referenceType, and invoice totals when referenceType is STUDENT_FEE_INVOICE. Sets `studentFeePayment_id`.

query.description: referenceNumber, transactionId, payment id, payee id, student name/scholar/email/mobile/enroll

request.description:
**GET /studentFeePayment**

Paginated list from **student_fee_payment** + payee summary (no invoice math).

**Query:** `page` (default 1), `limit` (default 20, max 100), optional `payeeId`, optional `search`.

**search** matches: referenceNumber, transactionId, receivedBy, studentFeePaymentId, payeeId, or student fields.

**data.payments[]:** payment fields (incl. **receivedBy**) + **payee**.

**paginationData:** page, limit, total, totalPages.

**GET /studentFeePayment/single?studentFeePaymentId=**

Single payment receipt / print view.

**data:** full **student_fee_payment** row (payeeType STUDENT|VENDOR|OTHER) + **payee** (expanded student when payeeType is STUDENT; else `{ payeeId, payeeType }`) + **paymentItems[]** (paymentItemId, paymentId, referenceId, referenceType, amount, timestamps).

Use `studentFeePayment_id` from POST step 2.

item.name: asset
item.description:
## Asset module (all APIs)

**Auth:** Bearer `{{token}}` — institute from token.

### Run order
1. **assetCategory** → 2. **asset** → 3. **assetIssue** (issue → return)

### assetCategory
| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| POST | `/assetCategory` |
| GET | `/assetCategory` |
| GET | `/assetCategory/single?assetCategoryId=` |
| PATCH | `/assetCategory` |
| DELETE | `/assetCategory?assetCategoryId=` |

### asset
| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| POST | `/asset` |
| GET | `/asset/codepreview?name&assetCategoryId` — preview next auto code (read-only) |
| GET | `/asset?page&limit&status&search` (`status`: all \| assigned \| unassigned; `search`: name, code, category) |
| GET | `/asset/single?assetId=` |
| PATCH | `/asset` |
| DELETE | `/asset/inventory?assetInventoryItemId=` |
| DELETE | `/asset?assetId=` |

### assetIssue
| Method | Path |
|--------|------|
| POST | `/assetIssue` |
| GET | `/assetIssue?page&limit&search` (no payments) |
| GET | `/assetIssue/single?assetIssueTransactionId=` |
| GET | `/assetIssue/payments?assetIssueTransactionId=` |
| PATCH | `/assetIssue` |
| POST | `/assetIssue/return` |
| GET | `/assetIssue/return?page&limit` (no payments) |
| GET | `/assetIssue/return/payments?assetReturnTransactionId=` |

### Codes (auto-generated)
- **Asset master:** `{categoryPrefix}-{nameSlug}{seq}` e.g. `FURN-TBL001` (Table in Furniture → `FURN` + `TBL` + `001`)
- **Inventory copy:** `{assetCode}-{copy}` e.g. `FURN-TBL001-0001`
- Sequence resets per category + asset name slug (same name → `001`, `002`, …)
- Do **not** send `code` on create/update — server assigns it

### Inventory (POST create / PATCH append)
Use **`inventoryBulk[]`** only. Each row: **`count`** required (min 1); **`classRoomSectionId`** optional (omit or `null` → `NOT_ASSIGNED`). PATCH appends new copies only; does not update existing lines.

### Enums
- **asset.status:** `IN_STOCK` \| `ISSUED` \| `MAINTANANCE` (derived; do not send on create)
- **asset_inventory_item.status:** `NOT_ASSIGNED` \| `ASSIGNED`
- **asset.condition / returnCondition:** `GOOD` \| `FAIR` \| `EXCELLENT` \| `BAD`
- **paymentMethod:** `cash` \| `credit_card` \| `bank_transfer` \| `cheque`

**Vars:** `assetCategory_id`, `asset_id`, `assetInventoryItem_id`, `assetIssueTransaction_id`, `assetIssueInventoryItem_id`, `assetReturnTransaction_id`, `class_room_section_id`, `student_id`, `asset_search`

item.name: assetCategory
item.description:
## assetCategory

**POST body:** `{ "name": "..." }` only — do **not** send `codePrefix` (server sets it from name).

| Name (seeded / example) | `codePrefix` |
|-------------------------|-------------|
| IT Assets | IT |
| Furniture & Fixtures | FURN |
| Software & Licenses | SWL |
| Custom e.g. Electronics | ELEC (derived) |

**PATCH:** `assetCategoryId` + optional `name`. Prefix is not changed on update.

Run **get all** after migration to pick an existing seeded category instead of **create**.

request.description:
**POST /assetCategory** — create category.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `name` | yes | Do **not** send `codePrefix` |

Response: `assetCategoryId`, `name`, `codePrefix` (e.g. IT Assets → `IT`). Sets `{{assetCategory_id}}`.

Prefer **get all** and use an existing seeded **IT Assets** row when migration has already run.

**Other examples (valid JSON only in Body):** `{ "name": "Electronics" }` → prefix `ELEC`. Seeded: Land & Buildings (`LDB`), Furniture & Fixtures (`FURN`).
**GET /assetCategory** — list categories for institute. Each row includes `codePrefix` (used for auto asset codes).
**GET /assetCategory/single?assetCategoryId=** — `assetCategoryId`, `name`, `codePrefix`.

**PATCH /assetCategory** — `assetCategoryId` required; at least `name`.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `assetCategoryId` | yes | |
| `name` | yes (on PATCH) | `codePrefix` is read-only — not accepted in body |
Fails if any **asset** rows still reference this category.

**POST /asset** — Create asset + inventory. **Do not send `code`** — response includes auto `code` (e.g. name **Table** in **Furniture & Fixtures** → `FURN-TBL001`) and `inventoryItems[].code` (e.g. `FURN-TBL001-0001`).

**`inventoryBulk[]`** (optional on create; omit key for master-only):

| Row field | Required | Notes |
|-----------|----------|--------|
| `count` | yes | Min 1 per row |
| `classRoomSectionId` | no | Omit or `null` → `NOT_ASSIGNED`; set → `ASSIGNED` |

Example: 2 in room + 2 unassigned = 4 copies. Unassigned-only: `"inventoryBulk": [{ "count": 4 }]`.

Required master: `name`, `condition`, `assetCategoryId`. Body must be strict JSON (no `//` comments).

**GET /asset/codepreview** — read-only preview of the next auto-generated asset `code` for `name` + `assetCategoryId`.

Does **not** save or reserve the code. **POST /asset** with the same `name` and `assetCategoryId` assigns the next available code at save time (usually matches preview unless another asset was created in between).

**Response:** `name`, `assetCategoryId`, `assetCategoryName`, `code` (e.g. `IT-DLL001`).

query.description: Optional. Partial match on asset name, code, or category name

request.description:
**GET /asset** — paginated list.

| Query | Default |
|-------|--------|
| `page` | 1 |
| `limit` | 20 (max 100) |
| `status` | `all` — filters nested `inventoryItems` only (`assigned` \| `unassigned`) |
| `search` | optional — partial match on asset `name`, `code`, or category `name` only |

**Response:** `data.assets[]` each with `totalInventory`, `issuedCount`, `nonIssuedCount`, `inventoryItems[]` (`issueStatus`: `issued` \| `available`), `pagination` (`page`, `limit`, `total`).
**GET /asset/single?assetId=** — asset master + `totalInventory`, `issuedCount`, `nonIssuedCount`, `inventoryItems[]` (code, barcode, status, `classRoomSectionId`, `classRoom`).

**PATCH /asset** — Same **`inventoryBulk[]`** as POST create. `assetId` required; at least one other field. Body must be strict JSON (no `//` comments).

| Optional | Purpose |
|----------|--------|
| `name`, `condition`, `description`, `assetCategoryId` | Master (`code` read-only) |
| `inventoryBulk[]` | Append copies: each row **`count`** required, **`classRoomSectionId`** optional |

Append-only example: `{ "assetId": 1, "inventoryBulk": [{ "count": 3 }] }`. Does not update existing inventory lines.
**DELETE /asset/inventory?assetInventoryItemId=** — 409 if issued and not returned.
**DELETE /asset?assetId=** — blocked if inventory exists or items still issued.

item.name: assetIssue
item.description:
## Asset issue / return (all APIs)

**Prerequisite:** **asset → create** first. Use `{{assetInventoryItem_id}}` on issue (must be `NOT_ASSIGNED` or returned).

| # | Method | Path | Notes |
|---|--------|------|--------|
| 1 | POST | `/assetIssue` | Issue; optional `securityAmount` |
| 2 | GET | `/assetIssue` | List — no payments |
| 3 | GET | `/assetIssue/single` | One issue — includes `securityPayment` if any |
| 4 | GET | `/assetIssue/payments` | Payments for `assetIssueTransactionId` |
| 5 | PATCH | `/assetIssue` | Update member/dates |
| 6 | POST | `/assetIssue/return` | Return lines; optional deposit settlement |
| 7 | GET | `/assetIssue/return` | List returns — no payments |
| 8 | GET | `/assetIssue/return/payments` | Return settlement (`assetReturnTransactionId`) |

**Return:** `returnCondition` required per item. `securityAmount` + `fineAmount` must be sent together for settlement. `paymentMethod`: `cash` \| `credit_card` \| `bank_transfer` \| `cheque`.

request.description:
**POST /assetIssue**

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `memberId`, `memberType` | yes | `STUDENT` or `TEACHER` |
| `issueDate`, `dueDate` | yes | `dueDate` >= `issueDate` |
| `items[]` | yes | `{ assetInventoryItemId }` — copy must not already be on open issue |
| `securityAmount` | no | Creates `ASSET_SECURITY` payment when set |
| `paymentMethod` | no | Default `cash`; also `credit_card`, `bank_transfer`, `cheque` |

Response: issue row + `items[]` + optional `securityPayment`. Sets `assetIssueTransaction_id`, `assetIssueInventoryItem_id`.
**GET /assetIssue** — paginated issues. Each row: `memberBasicDetails`, `issuedTotalItems` (lines on this issue), `returnedTotalItems` (returned lines), `items[]` (no payments).

**GET /assetIssue/payments?assetIssueTransactionId=** — payments for one issue.

Response: `memberBasicDetails` (issue member) + `payments[]` each with `payeeDetails` (name, scholarNumber/course for student; employeeName/code for teacher).

`paymentPurpose`: `ASSET_SECURITY` | `RETURN_SETTLEMENT`.

**GET /assetIssue/single?assetIssueTransactionId=** — same as list row: `issuedTotalItems`, `returnedTotalItems`, `items[]`, optional `securityPayment`. Use **get issue payments by id** for `payments[]` only.
**PATCH /assetIssue** — `assetIssueTransactionId` + optional `memberId`, `memberType`, `issueDate`, `dueDate`. Returns same shape as GET single.

**POST /assetIssue/return** — with deposit settlement.

| Field | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|--------|
| `returnDate` | yes | `YYYY-MM-DD`; >= each line `issueDate` |
| `items[]` | yes | `assetIssueInventoryItemId`, `returnCondition`, optional `damageNotes` |
| `securityAmount`, `fineAmount` | together | Both required to record settlement payment; omit both for return-only (see **return (no settlement)**) |
| `paymentMethod` | no | Default `cash` |

Sets `assetReturnTransaction_id`. Use **get return payments by id** for settlement details.
**POST /assetIssue/return** — return only (no `securityAmount` / `fineAmount`). No deposit settlement payment.
**GET /assetIssue/return** — `data.assetReturnTransactions[]` (`returnDate`, `items[]`), `pagination`. No payment rows (use **get return payments by id**).

**GET /assetIssue/return/payments?assetReturnTransactionId=** — settlement payment(s) for this return only.

Response: `memberBasicDetails` (member from returned lines) + `payments[]` each with `payeeDetails`. Empty `payments[]` if no settlement recorded.
